description_zh: Zoox 自动驾驶车直行接近路口减速让行右侧斑马线行人时，被后方跟车追尾，适用后车追尾+行人横穿的组合测试场景。

source_snippets: traveling northwest in the right lane of 9th Street and preparing to turn right onto Folsom Street
gradually slowed; its operator disengaged from autonomy and continued to slow to yield to a pedestrian with the right-of-way entering the crosswalk
a passenger car (Vehicle 2), traveling directly behind the Zoox vehicle, struck the left rear corner of the Zoox vehicle
evidence.reason: Ego 直行减速让行人（有驾驶决策），后车追尾符合 rear_hit，行人从路侧横穿符合 cross，无倒车/连环碰撞，可表达。
